text_block_list.text:
On the way to the trainer's office, seeing 
an Umamusume practicing her dance suddenly 
filled me with anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A dance lesson? ............Well... that's 
fine.

Such evasive words. Suspecting more and 
more that she might actually be slacking 
offâ

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Fret not, the dance is already perfected. 
Inside my head, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
To dance perfectly, one needs choreography 
memorization, rhythm, posing, facial 
control... and a whole variety of 
elements.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, the bottom line is simply moving 
this body exactly as imagined. That's my 
forte.
choice_data_list:
You seem confident, but... is that for 
real?
You seem confident, but... are you really?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Seeing is believing. Allow me to 
convince you firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Wait!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why are you here too, Air 
Groove-saaan～～～?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I merely happened to be passing by. I 
heard that you'd be putting on a dance 
performance, wasn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I, too, am interested in how your dancing 
turns out. ...Don't mind me, please 
continue.
choice_data_list:
It's just one more spectator in the crowd, 
isn't it?
It's just one more spectator in the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, Air Groove-san radiates several times 
more pressure than a normal person... 
Whatever. It's not like I have a choice 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: One-and-two-and...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(As long as I show them a flawless dance 
here— I should be able to slack off the 
rest of the time!)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Whew... I'm so glad I still remember the 
dance steps from earlier.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: So, how was it? My dance, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Does this satisfy you as well, Air 
Groove-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was well done.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still, you should be capable of reaching 
even greater heights. You seemed to lack 
focus in places. ...I take it you had 
other things on your mind.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Gah!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A split second of carelessness throws off 
your core and wavers your gaze. 
Consequently, it degrades the overall 
quality.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Brace yourselves more, and put more soul 
into it. —Come on, one more time!"
choice_data_list: Let's lean into it even more.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Wait, why are you getting all fired up 
too!?

I felt a great sense of dance from 
Rulership. In that case, I should 
definitely help her develop it.
choice_data_list: I want to see more of your cool dancing!
I want to see more of your cool dancing!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if you put it that way, I guess I 
have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Whether it's soul or passion, the crucial 
thing is 'how convincingly you project 
it.'"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I'll do it. For the one who commands this 
body is, and always will be, myself!

If I can move proactively rather than 
waiting for the sound, the quality should 
improve even further. Air Groove might 
even acknowledge me then.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I see. Making the first move, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Keep preliminary movements to a minimum so 
I can react instantly... and be ready to 
spring into motion the very moment the 
sound goes off.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What's left... leaning forward, perhaps? 
Shift my center of gravity forward, and 
see if I can increase my reaction speed 
for the next step.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of going with this strategy 
next, what do you think?
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's give that a try!
Yeah. Let's give that a try!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san! Next time, I'll definitely 
blow you away!
